FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Eternal Rest Funeral Home provides compassionate funeral and cemetery services, including personalized memorial planning, embalming, cremation, and burial services. Our facility is designed with a focus on comfort and dignity for both the deceased and their families. We maintain strict compliance with all necessary local and state licenses to ensure that our operations are both ethical and legally sound. Our staff includes licensed funeral directors and trained professionals who are committed to upholding the highest standards of care. We also have written contracts with trusted vendors to clarify liability and ensure quality service. We take pride in our sanitation and safety protocols, conducting regular training for our employees to mitigate risks. Our approach focuses on community engagement and building positive relationships, ensuring that we remain a trusted resource during difficult times.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any intentional acts or gross negligence and confirms adherence to all safety and sanitation standards through documented employee training programs. We maintain all required local and state licenses for our funeral and cemetery services, and we process funeral and memorial service linens separately from other commercial linens, ensuring full compliance with the applicable requirements.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 5, 2023, a $2,000 loss occurred due to water damage from a burst pipe in the embalming room. The issue was promptly addressed with repairs completed by January 15, 2023, and the status of the loss is closed.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Reinforced concrete burial vault with extra protective liner, Class A, labeled as "Standard Protection."
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Perimeter fencing and on-site security personnel to ensure safety and prevent unauthorized access to the premises.
